_why: The ONE postal address every email footer prints (CAN-SPAM 15 U.S.C. 7704(a)(5) needs a valid physical postal address). PHP reads it through alt_mail_postal_address(), Python through railway/postal_address.py. Change it here only. While 'street' is empty the footer keeps sending the interim line and railway/tests/test_postal_address.py requires the owner item named in 'pending_owner_item'.
name: AskTheRecruiter
pending_owner_item: Provide the postal address for email footers
